svg.text: Native navigation feel, phone mockup (dark, 412x915, layout A)
Round 2. Issue #37. Synthetic data. Tokens from web/tokens.css. Pink is redline only. Spec: native-nav-spec.md.
1 · Pull past the threshold
Finger 100 from scrollTop 0. Disc travel is 0.6x and stops at 56. Ring
closed: the 5ms tick fired at 72. Sync line reads Release to refresh. The
list does not move.
2 · Syncing
Released past 72. POST /api/refresh runs. Disc settles to travel 40 in
180ms and spins. Sync line reads Refreshing… without its own spinner.
3 · Failed
Refresh rejected or came back stale. Danger border, AlertIcon and a Sync
failed line for 1s, then the disc shrinks out in 150ms and the existing
SyncFailedBanner shows. No haptic.
4 · Rate limited
stale.kind is ratelimit and resetAt is ahead. Dashed disc with pause bars;
the ring never fills, so no tick and no request. The pill holds 1s after
release.

8 · Disc anatomy at 2x, every state

g.text: Disc at 2x. Values in CSS px. Fill button-default-bgColor-rest, 1px borderColor-default.
Ring r 9 (20 outer), stroke 2: track borderColor-emphasis, arc fgColor-accent, round caps.

svg.text: Callouts: 1 ring closed (full circle). 2 spinner arc, quarter turn. 3 AlertIcon from web/ui.tsx, 16.
4 pill: bgColor-muted, borderColor-default, 12/16 fgColor-muted, 24 tall, borderRadius-full.
State never rides on colour alone: ring shape, spinner motion, icon, dash and text carry it.
Back arrow at top left of sheets is #35 (another branch), drawn here as a 44 round iconbtn.
Disc sits under the header (z 3, header z 4), so it rises from behind the header edge.
Reduced motion: no spin (static quarter arc), no settle, shrink or slide; finger tracking stays.
